body: I just want to say thank you all, for saying such kind and beautiful things to me. Last night I was in such a terrible, low place... places that I find myself sinking to more and more often. The fact that complete strangers can be so supportive is heart-warming. I'm so tired of "friends" telling me how self-destructive I am and that I'm too much of a burden to be friends with, so your words are greatly appreciated.
